whyThisMatters: Someone has a letter that has to be on paper today. Postal Form takes the PDF, prints it, and sends it by USPS. The price starts at 3 dollars and 40 cents. United States. Founded in October 2024. There is no subscription, because each payment is for a letter. Stripe-verified means the listing is connected to Stripe. I do not log in and re-check the number. The 21 November 2026 sync shows 11,838 dollars in the last 30 days and 36,190 dollars all-time. The 7 October note, which was only a mention and not its own page, was about 6,647 dollars in the last 30 days and about 19,571 dollars all-time. All-time has nearly doubled since that mention. The figure comes through Stripe. USPS is the carrier. A legal notice or a tax letter is the usual job. The October mention did not have its own company page.
